company.name: Turbine
company.shortDescription: Turbine's platform understands the inner mechanisms of cancer enabling the discovery of novel targets & precision medicinal therapies.
company.description: Turbine builds a platform to understand the inner mechanisms of cancer, enabling the discovery of novel protein targets, precision biomarkers, and better translation to patients. Turbine uses its proprietary Simulated Cell technology in combination with Artificial Intelligence to build a faster and deeper biological understanding of therapeutic targets or indications, untangling the complexity of cancer.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-based simulation platform for modeling cellular responses to genetic and chemical perturbations and supporting drug discovery decisions with in silico experiments.
productsAndServices.name: Simulated Cell™ Virtual Lab

productsAndServices.description: A virtual screening product for selecting antibody–drug conjugate payloads or payload combinations, identifying responsive patient subgroups, and analyzing resistance mechanisms.
productsAndServices.name: ADC Payload Selector

productsAndServices.description: A computational target-identification and prioritization service that simulates perturbations, explains response and resistance mechanisms, and generates biomarker hypotheses for preclinical validation.
productsAndServices.name: Target Discovery & De-risking

productsAndServices.description: A tailored simulation service that uses customer datasets, therapies, and disease models to generate and interpret in silico predictions for portfolio and R&D decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Custom and Collaborative Virtual Disease Modeling

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Turbine combines ADC Payload Selector with Simulated Cell™ Virtual Lab.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.
